The full validator profile shows the candidate also takes findings from 1 to 78, interior_gap 0 to 62, jump7 2 to 19, urgent_jump 1 to 15, severe_jump 0 to 1, hand_worst 3 to 4. The INTERIOR_GAP records read '4 attacked notes with 1 unexplained interior string, needs positive audio evidence of fingerpicking or hybrid picking', which is a failure class this skill exists to catch.
what_it_bought: +11.8 points of paired-control audio separation on 170 notes, and a file margin of -2.4 to +0.9
verdict: the trade does not hold. 77 new findings including a severe jump against 11.8 points of separation is not a repair, and the checkpoint ledger had already refused the replacement before the licence overrode it.
file_kept: the candidate stays on disk, unpromoted, so the measurement can be re-examined
